note.question: How do consumers’ discount-seeking purchase deferrals affect online retailers’ return policy choices?
note.overview: Online shoppers value lenient return policies as they are unable to assess whether products match their expectations. This paper studies how consumers’ discount-seeking purchase deferrals affect online retailers’ return policy choices. Lenient returns may induce higher full-price sales by limiting consumer regret, while signaling clearance unavailability risk.
